title: Choice, Action, Consequence Cards
purpose: Help children retell Genesis 3 as a sequence of instruction, temptation, choice, and consequence.
body_markdown:
# Choice, Action, Consequence Cards

Cut into four cards or copy onto paper.

1. God gives a good instruction.
2. The serpent questions God’s words.
3. The people choose what God forbade.
4. The people feel shame, hide, and blame.

## Teacher note

Do not identify the fruit as an apple. Keep the activity fictional and do not request private confession.
